sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 13 July 2024, pitch SYN-SYNCP000021-P1 was put before Prairie Pediatric Center 021 on behalf of GSK PHARM.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 3 rebate of 5.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Meningococcal preferred-position minimum of 60 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
